parts.name: Vitrine
parts.about: Shows every code, Markdown, JSON, log and diff; the Markdown editor, the upload field and the icon picker.

parts.name: Pivotick
parts.about: Draws the graphs: the plan, the projects and what Claude is doing.

parts.name: xterm.js
parts.about: The terminal in the browser: Claude's panel, sessions, instances and their logs.

parts.name: Bootstrap
parts.about: The base of forms, buttons and tables, dressed in Cairn's colours.

parts.name: Font Awesome Free
parts.about: Every icon, Claude's own and the projects' included.

parts.name: IBM Plex
parts.about: The typefaces: Sans for the text, Mono for code and numbers.

parts.name: Flask
parts.about: The web server's pages and API.

parts.name: Flask-SQLAlchemy
parts.about: Ties the database to the web server.

parts.name: SQLAlchemy
parts.about: Reads and writes the database (SQLite, or PostgreSQL).

parts.name: Flask-Migrate (Alembic)
parts.about: Changes the database's shape from one version to the next.

parts.name: Pydantic
parts.about: Checks every input: forms, API and Claude's tools share the same schemas.

parts.name: Pillow
parts.about: Cleans and resizes the pictures you upload.

parts.name: Gunicorn
parts.about: Serves Cairn on Linux and macOS.

parts.name: Waitress
parts.about: Serves Cairn on Windows.

parts.name: platformdirs
parts.about: Finds where data belongs on each system.

parts.name: python-dotenv
parts.about: Reads the settings in .env.

parts.name: Psycopg
parts.about: Talks to PostgreSQL, when you choose it.

parts.name: Claude Code
parts.about: Your own Claude Code, opened in Cairn's terminals.

parts.name: MCP Python SDK
parts.about: Cairn's MCP server: how Claude reads and changes the plan.

parts.name: Claude Agent SDK
parts.about: For agent runs with an API key, later.

parts.name: Anthropic SDK
parts.about: Checks an Anthropic API key added in Accounts.

parts.name: ptyprocess
parts.about: The terminals behind the browser, on Linux and macOS.

parts.name: pywinpty
parts.about: The same on Windows.

parts.name: psutil
parts.about: Finds the processes and ports: instances, and every Claude on the machine.

parts.name: Git
parts.about: Your repositories. Cairn reads their branches from the files.

parts.name: GitHub CLI
parts.about: What Claude uses to answer a pull request.

parts.name: Docker
parts.about: The containers of a project, found with its instances.

parts.name: argon2-cffi
parts.about: Keeps your password as an Argon2id hash.

parts.name: cryptography
parts.about: Encrypts the vault (AES-256-GCM).

parts.name: keyring
parts.about: Keeps the vault's key in your system's keyring.

parts.name: PyOTP
parts.about: Two-factor sign-in codes.

parts.name: Segno
parts.about: The QR code to set up two-factor sign-in.

parts.name: Flask-Login
parts.about: Your session.

parts.name: Flask-WTF
parts.about: Protects every form and API write against forged requests (CSRF).

parts.name: Flask-Limiter
parts.about: Slows down password guessing.
